logo.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final square app icon/logo for the Chinese mobile parking game 《会停车吗你》, 1024×1024 pixels, 1:1 square.
Input images: Image 1 is the actual orange player car, a subject/style reference only. Image 2 is a gameplay color/context reference only. Create a NEW logo, not an edited screenshot.
Primary request: a bold, playful, immediately recognizable parking game icon that reads clearly at 64 pixels. One large orange compact car seen exactly top-down, slightly crooked inside a large cream-white U-shaped parking bay. The parking bay stays upright while the car is tilted about 20 degrees, making the parking challenge obvious. The car has dark blue-black windows and simple chunky tires, a simple readable silhouette based on the reference. Use the car and parking-bay geometry to fill most of the square with balanced breathing room.
Style/medium: clean polished 2D illustrated game brand mark, bold hand-cut geometric shapes, thick almost-black contour, one crisp offset ink-black hard shadow. Restrained neo-brutalist driving-school sticker aesthetic matching the game. Simplify car details for icon-scale legibility.
Color palette: full-bleed warm signal yellow #F3DF42 background, coral-orange #F05B32 car, warm cream #F5F1DF bay, ink #171815 contours, dark petrol glass.
Composition: one cohesive centered mark. At most one small bold black question mark near the empty corner of the bay, integrated into the composition. No words. No white external border, no device mockup, no rounded outer icon clipping, no multiple versions or design sheet.
Avoid: tanks, iron weights, people, faces, photorealism, realistic asphalt, gradients, 3D rendering, excessive texture, tiny decorative elements, arrows, speed lines, watermark. Opaque background.

cover.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: finished Xiaohongshu vertical game cover, exact 3:4 portrait composition, target 1200×1600 pixels, full bleed, ONE poster only.
Primary request: redesign the cover for the Chinese mobile parking game 《会停车吗你》, a witty, polished indie-game launch poster that looks native to the actual game, immediately readable in a feed thumbnail.
Input images: Image 1 is the new game logo, a BRAND STYLE AND ORANGE-CAR reference, not a pasted icon. Image 2 is the actual gameplay, a reference for top-down parking, parked blue cars, muted grey/sage training ground, cream panels, signal yellow, ink-black borders, and hard offset shadows. Do not copy the screenshot UI or old timers.
Art direction: bold neo-brutalist driving-school poster, warm cream paper, signal-yellow panels, coral-orange accent, almost-black hand-cut outlines, flat illustrated top-down cars with subtle painted highlights, clean crisp graphic screenprint finish. The visual identity must match the logo.
Layout: top approximately 42% is a very large, confident custom Chinese title treatment with generous margins. Top line exactly “会停车吗”, next line exactly “你？” in dramatically larger coral-orange/black lettering; title reads as the single name “会停车吗你？”. Strong typography, clean legible Chinese strokes, no distortions or missing strokes. Slightly playful baseline and one crisp hard shadow, no tiny text.
Lower approximately 50%: an orange top-down compact car turning diagonally toward a tight cream-white parking bay, a parked dusty-blue car and a parked sage car beside adjacent bays, grey-green training-ground surface and a short yellow/black striped curb. The orange car is the clear hero and matches the logo's shape, windows, headlights, black tires and thick ink outline. Suggest a parking puzzle through the car's crooked angle and empty bay, without drawn trajectory arrows. This is illustration of actual parking gameplay, not a racing scene. Keep full car bodies visible and the scene spacious enough to read.
Bottom cream footer, one short clearly readable exact text: “16关主线 · 三种车型”. No other copy. Keep important text and the main car comfortably inside the canvas safe area.
Avoid: tanks, iron weights, racing flags, explosions, faces, people, fake app UI, phone mockups, buttons, QR codes, logos of other brands, watermarks, photography, glossy 3D, gradients, stickers unrelated to parking, excessive decorative texture, English text, made-up rankings, any additional words. Opaque background.

export: Proportional resizing with sips; cover JPEG exported at quality 94. Original generated files remain unchanged.
